<noinclude><pagequality level="1" user="" />{{rh|CHA. IIII.|ACCORDING TO S. IOHN.|225}}</noinclude>{{c|{{larger|{{sc|Chap. IIII.}}}}}}

{{c|''Leauing Iewrie because of the Pharisees, in the way to Galilee he talketh vvith a Samaritane vvoman, telling her that he vvil giue vvater of euerlasting life, 16 shevving him self to knovv mens secretes, 19 preferring the Iewes religion before the Samaritanes, but ours (the Christian Catholike religion) before them both, 25 and vttering vnto her that he is Christ. 28 which by her testimonie and his preaching very many Samaritanes do beleeue: he in the meane time fore telling his Disciples, of the haruest he wil send them in to. 45 The Galilaeans also receiue him, vvhere againe he vvorketh his second miracle.''}} {{dropinitial|W|image=Rhemes New Testament 1582 initial W, foliage.png|imgsize=105px|fl={{verse|chapter=4|verse=1}}}}HEN {{sc|Iesvs}} therfore vnderstoode that the Pharisees heard that {{sc|Iesvs}} maketh mo Disciples, and baptizeth, then Iohn, {{verse|chapter=4|verse=2}}† (hovvbeit {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=∷ He did not baptize ordinarily. yet that he baptized his Apostles, S. Aug. thinketh it very probable, ''ep. 108''.}}∷ {{sc|Iesvs}} did not baptize, but his Disciples) {{verse|chapter=4|verse=3}}† he left Iewrie, and vvent againe into Galilee. {{verse|chapter=4|verse=4}}† and he had of necessitie to passe through Samaria. {{verse|chapter=4|verse=5}}† {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=''Gen. 48, 22.''}}* He commeth therfore into a citie of Samaria vvhich is called Sichar: {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=The Gospel vpō Friday in the 3 weeke in Lent.}}beside the maner that Iacob gaue to Ioseph his sonne. {{verse|chapter=4|verse=6}}† And there vvas there the fountaine of Iacob. {{sc|Iesvs}} therfore vvearied of his iourney, sate so vpon the fountaine. It vvas about the sixt houre.

{{verse|chapter=4|verse=7}}† There commeth {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=∷ This woman is a figure of the Church, not yet iustified, but now to be iustified. ''Aug. tract. 15 in Ioan''.}}∷ a vvoman of Samaria to dravv water, {{sc|Iesvs}} saith to her, Giue me to drinke. {{verse|chapter=4|verse=8}}† For his Disciples vvere gone into the citie, to bie meates. {{verse|chapter=4|verse=9}}† Therfore that Samaritane vvoman saith to him, How doest thou being a Ievve, aske of me to drinke, vvhich am a Samaritane woman? For the Iewes {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=∷ There were many other causes why the faithful Iewes could not abide the Samaritans, but their precise abstaining from their companie & cōuersation, was their Schismatical Temple and seruice in moūt Garîzim.}}∷ do not communicate vvith the Samaritanes. {{verse|chapter=4|verse=10}}† {{sc|Iesvs}} ansvvered, and said to her, If thou didst know the gift of God, and vvho he is that saith vnto thee, Giue me to drinke: thou perhaps vvouldest haue asked of him, and he vvould haue giuen thee {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=∷ He speaketh of his baptizing in the Holy Ghost. See Io. c. 7, 39.}}∷ c liuing vvater. {{verse|chapter=4|verse=11}}† The vvoman saith to him, Sir, neither hast thou vvherein to dravv, and the vvel is deepe: whence hast thou the liuing vvater? {{verse|chapter=4|verse=12}}† art thou greater then our father Iacob, who gaue vs the vvel, and him self dranke of it, and his children, and his cattel? {{verse|chapter=4|verse=13}}† {{sc|Iesvs}} answered, and said to her, Euery one that drinketh of this water, shal thirst againe: but he that shal drinke of the water that I wil giue him, shal not thirst for euer, {{verse|chapter=4|verse=14}}† but the vvater that I vvil giue him, shal become in him a fountaine of water springing vp vnto life euerlasting. {{verse|chapter=4|verse=15}}† The vvoman saith to him, Lord giue me this vvater, that I may not thirst, nor come hither to dravv. {{verse|chapter=4|verse=16}}† {{sc|Iesvs}} saith to her, Goe, call thy husband, and come hither. {{verse|chapter=4|verse=17}}† The vvoman ansvvered and said, I haue no {{hws|hus|husband.}}<noinclude>{{rh||Ff|band.}}</noinclude>
